messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning to roll out the new audit-envelope v4 for RBAC, KMS, and vuln triage events. Need a short customer validation plan + docs + changelog. 

raj: Additive-only or breaking? :eyes:

maya: Additive for most fields. We rename some keys to a nested shape (example: `actor_id` -> `principal.id`, `resource` -> `resource.path`). We'll keep a compatibility header for 6 weeks.

olivia: Documentation needs: mapping table (old->new), sample SIEM queries (Splunk/Datadog), and a small migration script customers can run against offline logs.

ben: Suggest we publish: 1) JSON Schema (`audit-v4.schema.json`), 2) sample payload pack, 3) a dockerized validator `redwood/audit-validator:latest` with a simple `ajv` check. Example run:
```
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/samples:/data redwood/audit-validator:latest ajv validate -s /schemas/audit-v4.schema.json -d /data/sample-1.json
```

maya: Canary plan: route 10% of events to v4 envelope for next 2 weeks; expose `x-redwood-audit-version: v4` header; fallback to v3 on incompat errors. Ops will monitor error-rate, latency, and customer reports.

audit-bot: automated tests: schema/regression/all-stages -> ✅ staging green, canary ready. Logs: `staging/audit-v4/test-run-2026-03-20.log`

olivia: Need to surface PII handling (redaction) explicitly. Add a section: `redaction-guidelines.md` and note which fields are redacted by default (principal.email, resource.owner_email).

customer-success: We'll draft the customer email and a support playbook. Include a sample query for SIEM users to validate mapping:

Splunk example:
```
index=redwood_audit | spath input=_raw | search event_type="auth" | table timestamp principal.id action resource.path outcome
```

Datadog example:
```
logs("service:redwood AND @event_type:auth").map( ... )
```

ben: Suggest adding a `compatibility` field in the envelope to copy original flat fields for ease of mapping:
```
"compatibility": { "actor_id": "team-123", "resource": "/models/gpt-6b" }
```

maya: Sample v4 payload (for docs):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_20260320_0001",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T15:12:00Z",
  "principal": { "id": "team-123", "type": "service_account" },
  "action": "model.deploy.version.update",
  "resource": { "type": "model", "path": "/models/gpt-6b", "id": "mdl_6b" },
  "metadata": { "kms_key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key1", "auth_method": "oauth2" },
  "outcome": "success"
}
```

raj: Do we need customer opt-in? For audit schema changes we keep enabled but provide opt-out flag via tenant setting `audit.envelope_version=v3` for 6 weeks.

olivia: Also create an RFC-style changelog entry in the docs site and a short 'what changed' snippet for the console UI and API docs.

maya: Action items:
- ben: publish schema + validator image + sample pack by EOD Thursday.
- olivia: draft docs + changelog entry + redaction guidelines.
- raj: implement canary routing + compat header.
- customer-success: prepare customer comms + support playbook.

maya: Any blockers?

ben: none, will PR the schema.

raj: should have infra notes in `eng-security` repo about KMS field mappings; I'll add.

customer-success: tagging @all on customer-facing draft when ready :email:

olivia: I'll include a one-page migration checklist for enterprise customers.

maya: Great — thanks everyone. Will post a short announcement in #announcements and in the product docs when canary starts. :shipit:
